description:
User approved page "Scalars without addresses" (https://claude.ai/artifact/6jYdi5cw1d27CZC85xkJih, From: Callables) on 2026-11-20, relayed by Callables. Owner: Callables. PARAMETERS ONLY (results wait for fz-9x7.44.1).

S1.5. A pipeline change, not a parameter swap: the sender's box goes to gift_copy_one, then the mailbox (process.rs:129 VecDeque<AnyValueRef>, a GC root at process.rs:876/893), GiftPayload::Message, park.rs msg, then MatcherFn. Covers fz-nml.9's int-message box. A walkthrough page comes before the build (Callables writes it). halt_implicit_ref, receive_pinned_ref, mark_published_ref_aliased, fz_fail, fz_system_halt and construction_failure_message need no change (no parameter can be a number); the census checks whether the failure record (process.rs:265) still needs it.

Census of origin/develop fb9ea0ec5 by Callables, 2026-11-20: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/98909c07-a0ca-4f82-8202-cb03fb090a79/scratchpad/census-44.3-7.md.

User decision on page v2 (https://claude.ai/artifact/2tR72wGWbDaMYinH29KHPK), 2026-11-21: one ticket, two commits (a: failure entries, b: messages) rather than split tickets. Kernel.send returns the message from the library.

comments.text: Re-sequenced by the user 2026-11-20 (relayed by Callables; page S1/S2b updated, https://claude.ai/artifact/6jYdi5cw1d27CZC85xkJih): PARAMETERS ONLY. Results stay as they are until fz-9x7.44.1 (after S2), because today's getters return a scalar as a ref into the container's slot with no box (heap/ref_io.rs any_value_ref_from_storage -> from_scalar_slot); a pair result before generated code can hold one would be boxed back. Parameters are safe: #807's stored_parts never boxes.

Callables, 2026-11-20: the failure record stays in scope. Raised { kind, value, name } (process.rs:264): once fz_throw/fz_exit/fz_panic take stored_value, Raised.value becomes a Stored (traced by kind; take() at ir_interp/backend.rs:2523 converts it back), or raise() (failure.rs:292) would box it again at :332. Handler-closure captures (materialize_outcome_closure, :324) already store (word, kind). The walkthrough page covers this.

title: Message and failure entries take a stored word and its kind
